title: Work on a branch
setup: git init -q . && git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main
printf '# Greeter\n' > README.md && git add README.md && git commit -qm 'Add README'

checks.name: nothing is left uncommitted (git status is clean)

hints: git switch -c feature/greeting creates the branch and moves you onto it.
Commit greeting.txt while you are on the feature branch, then git switch main.
